# Asamer Technologie

> Asamer Technologie GmbH (Lambach, Austria) and ASAMER s.r.o. (Brno, Czech Republic) sell, install and service woodworking machinery in the Czech Republic, Slovakia and Hungary and arrange its financing. Asamer is the exclusive distribution partner for OTT and an authorized dealer for Mayer, BARBARIC and Gannomat in these three countries. Used machines are inspected before handover; financing via leasing and grants is arranged on request.

The website exists in Czech (default), Slovak, Hungarian, German and English; language versions of each page are linked via hreflang. Contact: office@asamer.net, +420 724 056 965 (CZ), +43 664 26 33 132 (AT).

## Brands

- [OTT Paul – Authorized Dealer for CZ, SK and HU](https://asamer.cz/en/ott): OTT Paul (Austria) — edgebanding machines, CombiMelt and bluEdge featuring HyFuse gluing technology, return conveyors; Asamer is the exclusive distribution partner for CZ, SK and HU · CZ: https://asamer.cz/cz/ott
- [Mayer Panel Saws – Dealer for CZ, SK, HU](https://asamer.cz/en/mayer): Mayer — panel saws (Kappa Automatic for wood, Advanced Line for aluminium and plastics) · CZ: https://asamer.cz/cz/mayer
- [Barbaric Automation & Panel Handling – Dealer CZ, SK, HU](https://asamer.cz/en/barbaric): BARBARIC — panel storage, feeding, handling and vacuum lifters · CZ: https://asamer.cz/cz/barbaric
- [Gannomat Dowel Inserting Machines – Dealer CZ, SK, HU](https://asamer.cz/en/gannomat): Gannomat — dowel inserting, boring, fitting and pressing machines · CZ: https://asamer.cz/cz/gannomat
